ruleName: Ball moved when taking a practice swing
title: What happens if you move your ball on a practice swing?
question: On the fairway, you accidentally move your ball by brushing it during a practice swing. What should you do?

choices.text: Play the ball from where it moved to.
Replace the ball and add 1 penalty stroke.
Move the ball to a place you like better.

explanation: You must return the ball to its original spot and add 1 penalty stroke if you move it while making a practice swing.

juniorVersion.title: If your ball moves when you practise your swing, what should you do?
juniorVersion.question: You are on the fairway and you accidentally touch your ball with your club during a practice swing. The ball rolls away. What should you do?

choices.text: Hit the ball from where it stopped.
Put your ball back to where it was and add 1 extra shot.
Move the ball to a place you like more.

juniorVersion.explanation: If you make your ball move during a practice swing, you must put the ball back where it was and add 1 extra shot to your score.

vocabulary.simpleMeaning: Swinging your club to get ready, but not hitting the real shot.
The short grass area that leads to the hole.
An extra shot added to your score as a penalty.

juniorVersion.teachingTip: Show a simple demonstration of a practice swing and what to do if the ball moves. Use cones or a coin to mark where the ball started.
likelyMisconceptions: Children may think they can play the ball from its new spot.
Children might forget to add a penalty stroke.
Children might think they can move the ball to anywhere else.
